result.topic_en: An alternative definition of a lattice-point counting function S for a complex number z = x+iy, using indicator functions of points by parity of their coordinates (or the area of a square), with a recursion; the lower half of the page has unrelated sketches and an upside-down table of household accounts.
result.transcription:
Man kann die Definition auch so machen
[-z von P bis Q-]
$Sz = \Sigma\{\frac{z}{2}, -\frac{1}{2}i, \frac{z'}{2}, +\frac{1}{2}i\} - \{\frac{z}{2}+\frac{1}{2}, -\frac{1}{2}i, \frac{z'}{2}, +\frac{1}{2}i\}$
$= x+iy$
[-Ist-] P sei indefinite ein Punkt. Wir bezeichnen
durch die Zahl wenn oder die Zahl in den übrigen Fällen
$L.P$ 1 $[x]$ und $[y]$ beide gerade 0
$L'P$ 1 $[x]$ ungerade $y$ gerade
$L''P$ 1 $x$ und $y$ beide ungerade
$L'''P$ 1 $x$ gerade $y$ ungerade
oder $LP$ sei das Contentum des Quadrats $\frac{1}{2}P, \frac{1}{2}P-\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}P-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2}i, \frac{1}{2}P-\frac{1}{2}i$
$Siz = Sz - LP + LP'$

methods.what: Alternative definition of the counting function S(z) as a difference of sums over squares with vertices built from z/2 and its conjugate
Indicator functions of a point P = x+iy according to the parity of its coordinates
Alternative definition of LP as the area of the square with vertices P/2, P/2-1/2, P/2-1/2-i/2, P/2-i/2
methods.quote: oder $LP$ sei das Contentum des Quadrats $\frac{1}{2}P, \frac{1}{2}P-\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}P-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2}i, \frac{1}{2}P-\frac{1}{2}i$
